meta.title: Removing luck — what persists and what reverts
meta.policy: Luck cannot be deleted; it can be priced via explicit gates.

rows.metric: Pythagorean expectation vs actual win% (exponent 2.37, 877 team-seasons)
rows.interpretation: Points for/against explain most of win% — records are largely score-driven, not independent skill signal.
Typical team over-/under-performs its points-based expectation by ~1 win; large deviations are common.
Last season's luck does not carry forward — deviation was noise, not skill.

rows.metric: Year-over-year correlation of one-score win rate
rows.interpretation: Weak persistence; not used in any strategy given multiple-testing concerns.

rows.value: Deflated Sharpe p<0.05 + BH q≤0.10 + bootstrap lower bound >0
rows.interpretation: Every strategy must survive permutation null calibrated to variants tried; 0 of 7 do.
